The 3.65 A name refers to the intense (002) diffraction peak, not a cubic lattice parameter. The source describes an A-site-vacant hydroxide perovskite framework of alternating Mg(OH)6 and Si(OH)6 octahedra. Nominal MgSi(OH)6 is retained: electron-microprobe Mg/Si=1.02+/-0.06 and thermogravimetric water=34+/-3 wt.% support the ideal composition. The EOS sample contained traces to about 10% 10 A phase in some illuminated regions. The experimental and GGA reference volumes are intentionally different.
